details.report:
Implemented and committed the bounded append-only Reviewer evidence projection.

Changes:
- Replaced arbitrary Agent-call/persisted-message/bash lifecycle APIs with typed reviewer-dispatch/reviewer-agent event append projection.
- Records immutable rejection, acceptance inputs/materials/grants/range/target/prompts, irreversible start, and axis-keyed runner result/usage/workspace evidence.
- Mechanically validates prompt UTF-8 length/SHA/exact bytes, shared pinned target, dispatch cardinality, established-Spec two-axis completion, and no-Spec Standards-only completion.
- Defensively clones/freezes all projected evidence; duplicate starts/acceptances/results are rejected.
- Preserved fatal infrastructure capture and blocking behavior.

TDD evidence:
- RED: focused suite failed 4 tests with `ledger.append is not a function` before implementation.
- GREEN: `node --import tsx --test test/reviewer-execution-ledger.test.ts` — 5/5 pass.
- Focused typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions src/reviewer-execution-ledger.ts test/reviewer-execution-ledger.test.ts` — pass.
- Same-pattern check: obsolete ledger Agent attempts, persisted assistant batches, bash transcript, skill expansion, accept/reject/start decision methods were deleted rather than retained alongside the projection.
- Introduced-regression check: focused tests pass and `git diff --check` passes; worktree clean.
- Behavior-fact checks cover established Spec, no-Spec, rejection no-start isolation, monotonic duplicate/mismatch rejection, defensive freezing, and fatal infrastructure evidence.

Full `npm run typecheck` currently fails only at the explicitly residual integration seams: `src/reviewer-role.ts` still calls the removed lifecycle API; `src/role-runtime.ts` still re-exports obsolete ledger types; existing reviewer-role/auditor tests still construct/assert old record fixtures. Exact next integration is to emit dispatch/runner events from reviewer-dispatch/reviewer-agent, append them in reviewer-role, update auditor consumption to the new projection, and replace old role/auditor fixtures. Per slice authority, those files were not wired or modified here.
